about_the_game:
In Fields of Fortune, you begin your journey on a small island – equipped with nothing but a few tools and the dream of building something of your own. You’ll plant crops, build structures, and gradually grow your very own farm.

As you progress, new opportunities open up: craft tools, refine resources, and travel to other islands to discover rare materials. Head into town to sell your goods or take on tasks that reward you with useful bonuses.

Animals will also become part of your farm. Feed and care for them, build enclosures, and collect valuable products. You choose how you want to play – whether it’s a relaxed experience or a well-optimized production chain.

What to Expect in the Demo:

  • A handcrafted pixel world with farming and crafting mechanics

  • Place buildings, paths, and fields freely

  • Basic trading features available in town

  • A guided tutorial introducing the game’s core mechanics

  • The tutorial can be replayed as often as you like

    Note: The demo ends after completing the tutorial.

Not Included in the Demo:

  • Procedurally generated island exploration (available in the full game)

  • Saving and loading game progress

  • Advanced crafting recipes (only those needed for the tutorial are unlocked)

  • Full trader inventory – limited to tutorial-relevant items

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Onboard-Grafikkarte (Intel HD Graphics oder vergleichbar)
  • DirectX: Version 10

short_description: Get a first taste of Fields of Fortune! Start your farm, collect resources, and explore the world in this playable prologue. Some features are limited – saving and loading are not available in the demo.
